SRC-019:R2.text: CORE-002 P1: crew.py crew_snapshot / _project_facts -- stable = source_stable and dependencies_stable is decided at line 918 BEFORE project_facts=_project_facts(root) at line 924, so applicability facts sit outside the source stability barrier. SRC-019:R5.text: W2-002 P1: audit_enqueue.py enqueue COMMITTED retry branch / _placed_digest / _result -- when _placed_digest returns None the code unconditionally reads allocator COMMITTED plus absent layer as consumed by the journaled cleanup and returns ok=true, idempotent=true, present=false without any capture or consume receipt. Reproduced: enqueue op-1, delete audit/1.md before any inbox capture, retry the same op, got successful idempotent acknowledgement for a payload that exists nowhere. Require exact downstream binding proof, or re-place the same reserved layer, or refuse DELIVERY_LOST

SRC-019:R6.text: W2-003 P1: audit_inbox.py read_binding / classify / bind_layer / status / provenance_trace -- read_binding maps FileNotFoundError, any OSError, invalid UTF-8, invalid JSON and a wrong root shape to the same synthetic empty binding, so a following bind_layer LAUNDERS corrupt authority into a healthy document holding only the new record. Reproduced: {broken replaced by a valid file containing only audit/2.md; a persisted generation=oops crashes classify with ValueError. Add a strict BINDING_ABSENT/OK/CORRUPT decoder consumed by every read and mutate path, fail closed on mutation, never overwrite corrupt bytes
